llamacpp local provider routes requests via llamacpp/ model prefix with no auth

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"llamacpp/my-model\"}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
